emissions.statement: First-round audience emphasis is missing: brand directions need an owner decision on whether to lead with individual developers using agents day to day or teams standardizing agent workflows.
emissions.recommendation: Choose one lead audience for first-round direction work while preserving the confirmed broader audience of developers and teams using AI coding agents.

emissions.statement: Buyer-versus-user split is missing: sources do not define procurement roles, executive buyers, or departmental segments beyond developers and teams.
emissions.recommendation: Keep buyer and user unified as capable technical users unless later owner evidence adds separate buying roles.

emissions.statement: Secondary audience ranking is missing: sources do not choose whether agentic coding environment builders or multi-agent workflow operators should lead as the secondary audience, or whether they should remain co-secondary.
emissions.recommendation: Keep both secondary audiences co-secondary until brand-decisions records a ranked emphasis.
